supplementalInjuryCheck.note: Official reports control every displayed player status. Matching wording is not proof of game-day availability. Trial-only injuries and diagnoses are not published. Starting lineups are not provided.

coachChangeTrial.note: First-game-after-dismissal indicator tested with earlier-game training only. Small, incomplete event sample; not independently validated. No automatic score bonus or main-model promotion.

historicalReplay.note: Earlier-date residual training; same games for both models. Reconstructed inputs were retrieved later. Casebook games may be included; this is development evidence, not independent proof or issued picks.

upsetResearchTrial.method: Ridge penalty 30 on three standardized matchup features, fitted to expanding-date core-margin residuals. Minimum 60 earlier residuals. Core uncertainty retained; no manual injury penalty. No automatic promotion.

modelLimit: Protection, run resistance and touchdown drives now feed a separate experimental forecast. Main picks are unchanged. Starting roles, injury effects and weather are not fitted. Reported QB concerns exclude a game from automated tickets.
